messages:
Eli: Quick design check — noticed focus ring in dark console is nearly invisible on chart overlays. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/shot.png
Priya S.: Good catch. Which component? the chart hover tooltip or the legend items?
Eli: Legend items and interactive histogram bins. When you tab through, the outline blends into the gradient.
Maya L.: I can repro. On mac + Safari it's almost 0. Contrast ratios: measured ~2.1:1 on top of the gradient.
Samir: Oof. WCAG target is 3:1 for non-text UI. We should either increase ring color luminance or add a 1px halo.
Priya S.: Leaning toward halo + subtle blur so we don't brighten the whole palette. Example CSS: ```css
:root[data-theme="dark"] .focus-ring { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.06), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); outline: none; }
```
Maya L.: That looks promising. But on tiny tokens the halo eats visual space. Maybe only apply halo on high-density overlays (charts) and keep the current ring for buttons.
Eli: Also tokens in the token-heatmap have low saturation — code syntax highlights look washed on dark bg. Thoughts on desaturating greens/reds but bumping mid-tone luminance?
Samir: For syntax, we can use HSL tweaks: keep hue, reduce saturation 10-15%, raise lightness by 6-8% for readability. We tried a similar tweak in console v1.
Priya S.: Can we run a quick A/B on: A) halo + small luminance bump to foreground B) stronger inner 1px ring + no halo. Measure perceived contrast and click/keyboard usability.
DesignBot: Automated contrast check results: legend focus area — baseline 2.1:1, variant A 3.4:1, variant B 3.1:1. Accessibility alert: Variant A passes 3:1.
Maya L.: Also need to check chart color legends with colorblind-safe palette. Current red/green pair fails for deuteranopia.
Eli: Agreed — prefer orange/teal for delta bars. Samir, can you propose exact hexes?
Samir: Will post a small tokens.json with hexs. Quick ones: orange #FF9A3A, teal #37C6B8, neutral grid #22242A
Priya S.: Copy tweak: change "Show focus" to "Keyboard focus ring" in the keyboard settings modal — less ambiguous.
Eli: Nice. Let's get a quick prototype in Figma, I can test keyboard flow.
Maya L.: I'll add checklist: keyboard nav, screenreader hint, colorblind palette, hover/active states. Expect PR by EOD.
Samir: Ping me when Figma link ready. I'll run visual-tests and a contrast CI job.
Eli: Thanks all :heart:
